headline: A post-training delivery benchmark separates model gains from successful service delivery
summary: An arXiv paper proposes a governed benchmark for agents delivering post-trained models, where stage-level decisions are scored from platform-recorded evidence and a held-out acceptance gate checks the delivered model. Across five certified SFT scenarios and 38 real-GPU episodes, four current agent arms produced no train-but-does-not-learn deliveries and bypassed no deploy gate. Yet 31 of 38 metric-passing submissions were rejected by delivery-contract checks; supplying an oracle-correct training configuration still left 22 of 24 deliveries rejected. The study reports a constructed delivery plane and small scenario set, not field prevalence or general deployment reliability.
